//: Rare end-game spear with a fuel tank in the shaft. Use it to light the head (br_flamero_mado_on), like the chainsaw's on/off pair. Found in Level 2 crew stores, on the Redeemer, at the Exchange's curios trader, and in museums and mansions; crafted only from br_flamero_schematic.
description: A long steel spear with a blackened, finned head.  A narrow fuel tank runs inside the shaft, feeding a ring of tiny jets behind the blade, and a brass valve sits under your forward hand.  Fill it with kerosene or gasoline and open the valve to wreathe the head in flame.  Unlit, it is still a fine spear.

effect.u_message: You open the valve.  With a soft whump, flame wraps the spearhead.

false_effect.u_message: You open the valve, but nothing catches.  The tank is empty, or it's too wet here.

//: Lit: adds heat damage (melee_damage heat plus the FLAMING flag's extra 1-8 and 'You burn ...' message), gives a little light, burns one charge every 3 turns (500 charges, about 25 minutes) and goes out by itself when empty or underwater.
description: A long steel spear with its head wrapped in hissing flame.  Every thrust burns as well as pierces, and now and then the flame leaps across and sets what you hit alight.  Use it to close the valve and put it out.

effect.u_message: You close the valve and the flame gutters out.

sound_message.str: Your Flamero-Mado spear hisses and crackles.

//2: Held lit, about 1 hit in 3 sets the target on fire (an on-hit spell; once_in 3 is the closest to 30% the hook allows).

//: Cast by a lit Flamero-Mado spear on what it hits (about 1 hit in 3): sets it burning for a few turns. Not learnable; no Magiclysm needed.

description.str: Flame leaps from the spear and catches.  You should never see this as a spell.

message: Flame leaps from the spearhead and catches!

//: The only way to learn the Flamero-Mado spear recipe. Spawns with the spear's rare caches.
description: Oil-stained blueprints folded into a plastic sleeve: a spear shaft hollowed for a fuel tank, a valve, a pilot light and a ring of jets behind the head.  The margins are full of crossed-out pressures and a note in red pen: "NOT FOR INDOOR USE."

//: End-game: Fabrication 8, Mechanics 6, welding and metalworking, and only from the schematic.
A found Flamero-Mado spear: some fuel left in the tank, and usually its schematic tucked with it.
What the Redeemer leaves behind: once in a while the spear it took from someone who came to kill it.
Backrooms Expanded: a Flamero-Mado spear in a museum case, about 1 roll in 160.
Backrooms Expanded: a collector's Flamero-Mado spear, about 1 roll in 250.
